findings.description: The separator condition was inverted to `not any_prefix_is_slash` when moving the code into get_help_spec. The original code used `"; "` for slash-prefixed options and `" / "` otherwise, so the new code swaps them for every option.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with secondary spellings and no slash prefix, such as `--shout/--no-shout`. Originally any_prefix_is_slash is False, so the separator was " / ". The new expression evaluates to "; ", so get_help_record now returns "--shout; --no-shout" instead of "--shout / --no-shout". Impact: the help output for the common boolean-flag case changes, and existing help-output tests for those options would fail. The intended behavior change in the commit title is about hidden options, not separators.
